faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.note: Have a question not listed here? Leave us an inquiry and your dedicated AE will reply.
items: Does it cost anything to request a preliminary diagnosis and proposal?

No, the preliminary diagnosis and tailored proposal are free of charge. Before any contract, we use our proprietary tool realGEO to check your Naver first-page presence, map listings, AI answer visibility, and website conversion setup. We then outline urgent priorities and send a tailored proposal with a quote.
Can we run campaigns without a Korean entity or local staff?

Yes. Consultations and reporting happen over email and video calls, while our in-house teams in Seoul handle Korean content production and media execution. Ad accounts and websites are created in your company's name from day one.
Can we commission just a single service, like influencer casting or performance ads?
Yes. You can start with one of our 8 solutions or combine several into an integrated scope. Even for a standalone service, a 1:1 dedicated AE is assigned to your account.
Who owns the ad accounts and accumulated campaign data?

You do. Ad accounts, websites, and map listings are opened in your company's name from the start, with WizThePlanning registered as an administrator. After the contract ends, every account and all historical data remain your property.
Do you guarantee search rankings or AI answer placements?

No, we do not guarantee rankings. Search positions and AI answers are determined by each platform's algorithms. Instead, we compare pre-launch baseline numbers against post-launch measurements candidly, including any metrics that declined.
What languages do you work in?
We work in English by email and video calls, and we also take inquiries in Chinese and Vietnamese. Korean-facing content is planned and written in Korean, not translated.
